BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to overpayments received by courts; and amendingRCW 63.29.130.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 63.29.130 and 1993 c 498 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Intangible property held for the owner by a court, state or othergovernment, governmental subdivision or agency, public corporation,public authority, or the United States or any instrumentality of theUnited States that remains unclaimed by the owner for more than twoyears after becoming payable or distributable is presumed abandoned.However, courts may retain overpayments made in connection with anylitigation, including traffic, criminal, and noncriminal matters, in anamount less than or equal to ten dollars. These overpayments shall beremitted by the clerk of the court to the local treasurer for depositin the local current expense fund.
